adolescent.en: The program helps each adolescent develop better study habits.
adolescent.zh: 這項計畫幫助每位青少年培養更好的讀書習慣。

align.en: The team will align its goals with the new project schedule.
align.zh: 團隊會讓目標與新的專案時程一致。

allocate.en: We should allocate more time to the most difficult section.
allocate.zh: 我們應該分配更多時間給最困難的部分。

appliance.en: This appliance uses less electricity than the older model.
appliance.zh: 這台家電比舊款更省電。

appraisal.en: The teacher gave a careful appraisal of our presentation skills.
appraisal.zh: 老師仔細評估了我們的簡報能力。

artificial.en: The experiment compared natural light with artificial light in the classroom.
artificial.zh: 這項實驗比較教室中的自然光與人工光。

assurance.en: The clear instructions gave students assurance before the final task.
assurance.zh: 清楚的說明讓學生在最後任務前更有信心。

attribute.en: Researchers attribute the improvement to regular practice and better feedback.
attribute.zh: 研究人員將這項進步歸因於規律練習與更好的回饋。

burden.en: Sharing the work can reduce the burden on each team member.
burden.zh: 分擔工作可以減輕每位組員的負擔。

capacity.en: The hall has enough capacity for all graduating students and families.
capacity.zh: 這座禮堂的容量足以容納所有畢業生與家人。

circulate.en: The teacher asked students to circulate the survey among their classmates.
circulate.zh: 老師請學生把問卷傳給班上同學填寫。

cooperate.en: Students must cooperate closely to finish the group project on time.
cooperate.zh: 學生必須密切合作，才能準時完成小組專題。

dedicate.en: She plans to dedicate an hour each evening to reading English.
dedicate.zh: 她打算每天晚上撥一小時專心閱讀英文。

dense.en: The dense fog made the distant buildings difficult to see.
dense.zh: 濃霧讓遠處的建築物很難看清。

derive.en: Students can derive the answer from the information in the graph.
derive.zh: 學生可以從圖表中的資訊推導出答案。

device.en: The device records temperature changes throughout the entire experiment.
device.zh: 這個裝置會記錄整個實驗期間的溫度變化。

diminish.en: Regular maintenance can diminish the risk of unexpected system failure.
diminish.zh: 定期維護可以降低系統意外故障的風險。

disclose.en: The report must disclose the source of every important statistic.
disclose.zh: 這份報告必須揭露每項重要統計資料的來源。

discrete.en: The chart divides the results into several discrete categories.
discrete.zh: 這張圖表把結果分成幾個明確分開的類別。

draft.en: Please finish the first draft before asking your partner for feedback.
draft.zh: 在請同學提供回饋前，請先完成初稿。

elaborate.en: Could you elaborate on your idea with a concrete example?
elaborate.zh: 你可以用一個具體例子進一步說明你的想法嗎？

enforce.en: Schools enforce safety rules to protect students during laboratory activities.
enforce.zh: 學校會執行安全規定，以保護進行實驗活動的學生。

entity.en: Each organization is treated as a separate entity in the database.
entity.zh: 資料庫會把每個組織視為獨立實體。

equip.en: The school will equip the new classroom with digital learning tools.
equip.zh: 學校會為新教室配備數位學習工具。

erode.en: Heavy rain can slowly erode soil on an unprotected hillside.
erode.zh: 大雨會逐漸侵蝕沒有保護的山坡土壤。

exhibit.en: The museum will exhibit student projects during the science festival.
exhibit.zh: 博物館會在科學節期間展出學生作品。

foster.en: Group discussion can foster curiosity and stronger communication skills.
foster.zh: 小組討論可以培養好奇心與更好的溝通能力。

fundamental.en: Clear communication is fundamental to successful teamwork in any project.
fundamental.zh: 清楚溝通是任何專案成功合作的基本要素。

generate.en: The new system can generate a summary from the collected data.
generate.zh: 新系統可以根據蒐集的資料產生摘要。

highlight.en: Use the final paragraph to highlight the main conclusion of your report.
highlight.zh: 請用最後一段凸顯報告的主要結論。

implement.en: The school plans to implement the new recycling program next semester.
implement.zh: 學校計畫下學期實施新的回收方案。

incline.en: The road begins to incline sharply near the top of the hill.
incline.zh: 道路接近山頂時開始明顯上坡。

induce.en: Bright light can induce faster growth in some young plants.
induce.zh: 強光可能促使某些幼苗生長得更快。

intervene.en: A teacher may intervene when a group discussion becomes unproductive.
intervene.zh: 當小組討論失去成效時，老師可能會介入。

invoke.en: The program can invoke a backup process when an error occurs.
invoke.zh: 程式發生錯誤時可以啟動備援程序。

likewise.en: The first group improved its score, and the second did likewise.
likewise.zh: 第一組提高了分數，第二組也同樣有所進步。

mature.en: A mature response considers both the problem and possible solutions.
mature.zh: 成熟的回應會同時考慮問題與可能的解決方法。

maximize.en: A clear schedule can maximize the time available for exam review.
maximize.zh: 清楚的時程可以最大化可用於考試複習的時間。

notion.en: The lesson challenged the common notion that faster is always better.
notion.zh: 這堂課挑戰了速度越快就一定越好的常見觀念。

offset.en: Planting more trees can help offset some local carbon emissions.
offset.zh: 種植更多樹木可以幫助抵銷部分當地碳排放。

orient.en: The map helps visitors orient themselves inside the large museum.
orient.zh: 這張地圖幫助訪客在大型博物館內辨認方向。

overlap.en: The two circles overlap in the center of the diagram.
overlap.zh: 圖中的兩個圓在中央重疊。

precede.en: A short introduction should precede the detailed analysis in your report.
precede.zh: 報告中的詳細分析前應先有一段簡短介紹。

presume.en: Do not presume the answer before examining all the evidence.
presume.zh: 在檢視所有證據前，不要先假定答案。

prior.en: Prior experience with the software can make the task easier.
prior.zh: 先前使用這套軟體的經驗可以讓任務更容易。

prohibit.en: School rules prohibit students from entering the laboratory without permission.
prohibit.zh: 校規禁止學生未經允許進入實驗室。

proportion.en: A large proportion of students preferred the shorter reading passage.
proportion.zh: 很大比例的學生比較喜歡較短的閱讀文章。

pursue.en: She hopes to pursue further study in environmental science someday.
pursue.zh: 她希望未來繼續深造環境科學。

reconcile.en: The team tried to reconcile the two different sets of results.
reconcile.zh: 團隊試著調和兩組不同的結果。

reluctant.en: He was reluctant to change the plan without more evidence.
reluctant.zh: 在沒有更多證據前，他不太願意改變計畫。

restrain.en: The barrier helps restrain water during periods of heavy rainfall.
restrain.zh: 這道屏障有助於在豪雨期間控制水流。

rigid.en: A rigid schedule may be difficult to follow when plans change.
rigid.zh: 當計畫改變時，過於僵化的時程可能很難遵守。

scope.en: The project expanded its scope to include students from three schools.
scope.zh: 這項專題擴大範圍，納入三所學校的學生。

sole.en: Cost should not be the sole reason for choosing a solution.
sole.zh: 成本不應該是選擇解決方案的唯一理由。

specify.en: Please specify which source you used for each important claim.
specify.zh: 請註明每項重要主張使用了哪個來源。

terminate.en: The system will terminate the process if a serious error appears.
terminate.zh: 如果出現嚴重錯誤，系統會終止該程序。

transmit.en: The sensor can transmit temperature data to the computer wirelessly.
transmit.zh: 這個感測器可以無線傳送溫度資料到電腦。

trigger.en: A sudden change in temperature may trigger the warning system.
trigger.zh: 溫度突然改變可能會觸發警示系統。

uniform.en: All samples were kept under uniform conditions during the experiment.
uniform.zh: 所有樣本在實驗期間都維持一致的條件。

whereby.en: The class created a system whereby each student could share feedback.
whereby.zh: 全班建立了一套讓每位學生都能分享回饋的制度。
